risks.title: Leverage Decay Risk
risks.context: 49% of the portfolio is invested in leveraged ETFs, which amplifies both gains and losses.
risks.body: The portfolio's leverage could lead to significant losses if the market declines. The 3x leverage amplifies the S&P/NASDAQ/Dow both ways, increasing the potential for large losses.

risks.title: FX Exposure Risk
risks.context: 68% of the portfolio is denominated in USD, which exposes the portfolio to FX risk.
risks.body: The portfolio's FX exposure could lead to losses if the USD/CAD exchange rate fluctuates. A strong US dollar could decrease the portfolio's value when converted to CAD.

risks.title: Earnings Concentration Risk
risks.context: The portfolio has a significant concentration of tech stocks, which could be impacted by earnings reports.
risks.body: The portfolio's tech holdings could be impacted by earnings reports, which could lead to a decrease in value if the reports are disappointing.
